messages:
maria: Heads-up — while working on the dashboard docs migration I found a rows/count mismatch in the cost widget example. The sample shows 3 rows but the query returns 4, which breaks the embed preview in the Console docs. PR with failing preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :eyes:

olivia: Oof. Can you paste the example widget config and the query output? want to repro locally.

maria: Sure — snippet from the docs (inline YAML):
```yaml
widget: cost_breakdown
rows: 3
query: |
  SELECT scope, sum(cost) as total
  FROM billing
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
  GROUP BY scope
  ORDER BY total desc
  LIMIT 4
```
The query uses LIMIT 4 but rows is set to 3 — looks like an accidental copy/paste from an older example.

taylor: That explains the embed render error. Quick fix is to make rows: 4 or change LIMIT to 3. Which is the intended example in the Console UX?

olivia: UX wants the top-3 breakdown for the screenshot. So change limit -> 3. But also check downstream SDK snippet in docs that builds the same payload — we have a node+py example.

maria: Good call. There's a node sample in the same page that constructs the widget payload dynamically: `const rows = data.rows.length` — but it expects 3. I'll update both the SQL and the widget sample in the PR.

sanjay: FYI when you update the SDK snippet, watch out for the trace hook param name change from `trace_id` -> `traceId` in the latest trace client — we had a few broken examples after that rename. Search repo for `trace_id:` and we'll need to standardize.

maria: Thanks, will grep. I found one Python snippet using `trace_id`: docs/guides/observability/examples/tracehook_py.md line ~72.

ci-bot: build/docs-preview #482 — checking... :hourglass:

olivia: Also add a tiny note about cost rounding — the Console frontend now rounds to 2 decimals, older screenshots were unrounded which confuses reviewers.

maria: Added a one-liner comment in the PR and updated the screenshot alt-text. Pushed commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/9f8cba7

ci-bot: build/docs-preview #482 — success :white_check_mark: (preview URL: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.com)

taylor: Quick follow-up: can we add a short QA checklist in the docs repo for embed examples? items: SQL limit vs rows, SDK payload parity, trace param names, rounding/display. Should live in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md.

maria: On it — will open a small PR to add the checklist after this merges.

sanjay: If you want, I can run a grep + simple linter to flag mismatched LIMIT vs rows across markdowns. Could run as a CI job in docs repo.

olivia: That would be awesome. reduces these trivial regressions. :raised_hands:

maria: Agree. For now, merging the quick fix. Thanks everyone for the quick responses. :shipit:
